basis: Author verdict (2026-11-09). The 16,556 link-layer (kernel-module granularity) AT-only pairs. Boundary = kernel module (the analysis unit of the link layer); reviewer guideline audit v2.1, P1-P5. Reference only: the paper reports the unit-boundary verdict (at_only_unit_judgment.json); at the kernel-module boundary the 36 other-unit callbacks become intra-module calls and 15 entry points remain (Sections 3.7 and 5.10).

export_addressable_only.rule: references only the EXPORT_SYMBOL by-product globals (__UNIQUE_ID_*addressable_*) -> callable by name only -> exported-service (0)

select_phi_ret_only.rule: phi/select result is called indirectly at once or only compared (no sink reached) -> internal-dispatch / immediate call (0)

call_arg_via_indirect_call.note: The callback address is passed as an argument of an indirect call (ops->fn(..., cb, ...)). FPEA C3 counts only the arguments of direct calls, so these are missed by design.

summary.design_gap: C3 does not count the arguments of indirect calls; C4 does not see the inline-asm xchg store of i915
